    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The checkpoints are an ordered list with one tab stop; the arrow keys move between them
      - listitem: Every row says its title, its attempt, its status and whether it's current or left behind; the current one has aria-current="step"
      - listitem: The Rewind button is a pointer shortcut – from the keyboard, Enter on the row does the same
      - listitem: The count in the bar on top is announced politely when it changes
      - listitem: "Status is never color alone: failed has a badge, stopped says so, the current checkpoint is announced"
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: A new checkpoint rises in, its dot pops and the line to it draws itself down – the card grows smoothly to make room
      - listitem: A rewind bends a new lane out of the checkpoint you picked and draws it down to the new attempt; the attempt you left turns gray and fades back
      - listitem: A new checkpoint's dot gets one short glint as it arrives; while the agent works toward it, its title shimmers
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything simply appears
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Every row has a fixed height, so nothing jumps when a checkpoint finishes or fails – Rewind takes the place of files and time
      - listitem: Past fourteen checkpoints the list scrolls inside the card and keeps the current one in view
      - listitem: Narrow, the task and the file counts give way first
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Never remove checkpoints after a rewind – add the new one with the rewound-to checkpoint as its parent; the old attempt stays and fades back by itself
      - listitem: Mark what the agent was working on when you rewind as "stopped"
      - listitem: "Lanes come from parent links alone: the first child keeps its parent's lane, every later child opens a new attempt"
      - listitem: The rail's blue is --ui-ackc-link (#82bcff), the same as Agent Tree; how far an attempt left behind fades is --ui-ackc-dim
